function.name: write
function.arguments:
{"path": "plot_precision_recall.py", "content": "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as patches

# Data for the three document retrieval systems
systems = {
    'BM25': {'precision': 71.2, 'recall': 68.4},
    'Dense Retrieval': {'precision': 74.5, 'recall': 79.3},
    'Hybrid': {'precision': 78.1, 'recall': 80.6},
    'Our Method': {'precision': 82.4, 'recall': 83.7}
}

# Create the figure and axis
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))

# Colors for different systems
colors = {
    'BM25': '#1f77b4',
    'Dense Retrieval': '#ff7f0e',
    'Hybrid': '#2ca02c',
    'Our Method': '#d62728'
}

# Marker sizes
sizes = {
    'BM25': 100,
    'Dense Retrieval': 150,
    'Hybrid': 200,
    'Our Method': 300
}

# Plot each system
for name, data in systems.items():
    ax.scatter(
        data['precision'], 
        data['recall'], 
        s=sizes[name], 
        c=colors[name], 
        label=name,
        edgecolors='black',
        linewidth=1.5,
        zorder=3
    )
    
    # Annotate each point with the system name
    ax.annotate(
        name,
        (data['precision'], data['recall']),
        textcoords="offset points",
        xytext=(10, 10),
        fontsize=10,
        fontweight='bold',
        color=colors[name]
    )

# Calculate and draw the Pareto frontier
# The Pareto frontier consists of points that are not dominated by any other point
# A point dominates another if it has both higher precision AND higher recall

# Sort systems by precision (descending) to find Pareto frontier
sorted_systems = sorted(systems.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]['precision'], reverse=True)

# Find Pareto frontier points (non-dominated points)
pareto_frontier = []
max_recall = -1
for name, data in sorted_systems:
    if data['recall'] > max_recall:
        pareto_frontier.append((name, data))
        max_recall = data['recall']

# Draw Pareto frontier line
pareto_precision = [systems[name]['precision'] for name, _ in pareto_frontier]
pareto_recall = [systems[name]['recall'] for name, _ in pareto_frontier]

# Connect Pareto frontier points with a dashed line
ax.plot(
    pareto_precision, 
    pareto_recall, 
    'k--', 
    linewidth=2, 
    alpha=0.7,
    label='Pareto Frontier'
)

# Add Pareto frontier annotation
ax.annotate(
    'Pareto Frontier',
    xy=(pareto_precision[0], pareto_recall[0]),
    xytext=(pareto_precision[0] - 15, pareto_recall[0] + 5),
    fontsize=11,
    fontweight='bold',
    color='black',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='black', lw=1.5)
)

# Highlight "Our Method" as the best performer
our_method = systems['Our Method']
ax.scatter(
    our_method['precision'], 
    our_method['recall'], 
    s=400, 
    c='#d62728', 
    edgecolors='black',
    linewidth=2.5,
    zorder=4,
    marker='*'
)

# Add annotation for Our Method being in top-right corner
ax.annotate(
    'Best Performance',
    (our_method['precision'], our_method['recall']),
    xytext=(our_method['precision'] + 3, our_method['recall'] + 3),
    fontsize=12,
    fontweight='bold',
    color='#d62728',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#d62728', lw=2)
)

# Set axis labels and title
ax.set_xlabel('Precision (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('Recall (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('Precision-Recall Trade-off for Document Retrieval Systems\non Legal QA Dataset', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Set axis limits with some padding
ax.set_xlim(65, 88)
ax.set_ylim(60, 90)

# Add grid for better readability
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add legend
ax.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=10, framealpha=0.9)

# Add text box explaining the plot
textstr = '\n'.join([
    'Top-right corner = best performance',
    'Higher precision and recall = better',
    'Pareto frontier = non-dominated solutions'
])
props = dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5)
ax.text(
    0.02, 
    0.98, 
    textstr, 
    transform=ax.transAxes, 
    fontsize=9,
    verticalalignment='top',
    bbox=props
)

# Add value labels near each point
for name, data in systems.items():
    ax.text(
        data['precision'] + 1,
        data['recall'] - 2,
        f'P: {data["precision"]:.1f}%',
        fontsize=8,
        alpha=0.7
    )
    ax.text(
        data['precision'] + 1,
        data['recall'] - 4,
        f'R: {data["recall"]:.1f}%',
        fontsize=8,
        alpha=0.7
    )

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('precision_recall_plot.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

print("Plot saved as 'precision_recall_plot.png'")"}
